proof_body:
by
  intro K F L _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ p P Q _ _ _ _ _ hp hP
  have h1 : Ideal.map (algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers F) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) P ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hP
  have h2 : Ideal.map (algebraMap (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) p ≠ ⊥ :=
    Ideal.map_ne_bot_of_ne_bot hp
  exact ⟨Ideal.ramificationIdx_algebra_tower h1 h2 (Ideal.map_le_of_le_comap (Ideal.LiesOver.over (P := Q) (p := P)).le), Ideal.inertiaDeg_algebra_tower p P Q⟩
target_source: ∀ (K F L : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Field L] [NumberField K] [NumberField F] [NumberField L] [Algebra K F] [Algebra F L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower K F L] (p : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) (P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers F)) (Q : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [p.IsMaximal] [P.IsMaximal] [Q.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p] [Q.LiesOver P], p ≠ ⊥ → P ≠ ⊥ → p.ramificationIdx Q = p.ramificationIdx P * P.ramificationIdx Q ∧ p.inertiaDeg Q = p.inertiaDeg P * P.inertiaDeg Q
